svg.title: What Kasir POS does
svg.desc: Cashier: Catalog with modifiers, tiered discounts behind a PIN, split payments, QRIS, cash, card machine, transfer and store credit. Kitchen display: Orders reach the kitchen screen live, so the line sees every ticket the moment the cashier sends it. Table QR self-order: Guests scan a table code, order from their own phone and the order lands in the cashier and kitchen flow. Inventory, recipes, COGS: Recipes link menu items to stock, so cost of goods updates from what was really used. Purchasing, price intelligence: Record supplier purchases and spot when a price moves. Reports and a daily owner report link follow the numbers. Staff and shifts: Roles with permissions, PIN login, attendance, shift schedules and cash handover at the close of a shift. CRM, loyalty, receivables: Customer records, loyalty and a clear list of who owes the shop money. Draft-only agents, audit trail: Agent actions never touch a sale. Every change lands in an append-only audit trail.
svg.text: The parts of Kasir POS people use every day.
